sentences.en: We don't go sailing as often as we used to.
sentences.zh: 我们不像以前那样经常去航海了。

sentences.en: Several yachts were sailing side by side far out at sea.
sentences.zh: 几艘帆船远远地在海上并排航行。

sentences.en: I saw a white cloud sailing across the sky.
sentences.zh: 我看见一朵白云飘过天空。

senses.zh: 航行，起航（sail的现在分词形式）
